levels.1: The selected route is the original amusement-machine release.
levels.2: Use an authentic Adelion cabinet distributed for the 2021 launch.
levels.3: Verify model plate, cabinet shell, reels, controls, display, side lighting, firmware, and service record before capture.

levels.1: Some archival lists use the announcement year.
levels.2: Record both the catalog year and the public cabinet-launch date.
levels.3: Keep the catalog's 2020 label in research metadata while identifying the verified hall introduction as February 2021. Do not split them into two machines.

levels.1: Completion never requires wagering.
levels.2: Use a lawfully owned cabinet configured for non-wager free play.
levels.3: Have an authorized owner follow operator documentation. Do not deposit money, seek payouts, bypass safety systems, or use public gambling to trigger content.

levels.1: Reels, controls, display, lighting, and audio act together.
